description:
Villain Arc is the workout app for lifters who want a plan that gets sharper every session — and an on-device AI coach that helps build it.

Track every set, ride a real progression curve, and let the app handle the math while you focus on the lift.

WHY VILLAIN ARC

— On-device AI coach. Generate a full program from a sentence, get smart exercise replacements, and review coaching events with your own ratings. Powered by Apple Intelligence, and generation runs entirely on your device.

— Six ready-made programs. Push/Pull/Legs, Upper/Lower, Full Body, Stronglifts 5x5, 5/3/1 BBB, and a 5-day Bro Split. One tap to materialize a full split or pull a single day into your editor.

— Live, set-by-set logging. Reps, weight, RPE, rest timer with circular countdown, set notes, and post-workout PR detection.

— Built for cardio too. Outdoor run, outdoor walk, treadmill run, treadmill walk. Outdoor sessions record routes with MapKit; treadmill sessions take manual speed and incline intervals, so you do not need a smartwatch to log a treadmill mile.

— Apple Health, two-way. Workouts, weight, sleep, steps, distance, energy, heart rate, resting heart rate, walking HR, HRV, respiratory rate, wrist temperature, and hydration.

— Sleep, RPE, and session-quality correlations. See which sleep durations and RPE ranges produce the workouts you rated highest, computed on-device from your own data.

— Sync through your FCT account. Your workouts, plans, splits, and cardio sessions reach every device you sign in on.

— Apple-native end to end. Siri Shortcuts, Spotlight, widgets for heart rate, sleep, weight, steps, energy, and hydration, Live Activities for active workouts and cardio sessions, and an Apple Watch companion app for the rest timer, the live session, and your heart-rate stats.

— No ads, and no third-party analytics or tracking SDKs. Your data is yours.

HEALTH INSIGHTS

The Trends dashboard surfaces sparkline cards for weight, sleep, resting heart rate, energy, steps, and workout volume across 7-, 30-, 90-day, and 1-year windows. Sleep Timing Insights show your average bedtime and wake time with a consistency score, and Correlation Insights pair every rated session with the sleep and RPE behind it.

PROFILE & PROGRESSION

A dedicated Profile tab shows your workout streak, muscle-map distribution across the last two months, a complete-day heatmap for workout, sleep, step, and hydration goals, and fitness-level review cues so the app never drifts from where you actually are.

PRIVACY

Villain Arc keeps two facts separate: where the work happens, and where the result is kept. Apple Intelligence runs entirely on your device. The sentence you type and the plan it writes are never sent to an AI provider.

Villain Arc requires a free FCT account. Your workouts, plans, splits, cardio sessions and their routes, and the goals you set are stored on FCT's cloud infrastructure (hosted on Supabase), scoped to your account, and readable by no other account. Deleting your account or just this app's data is a single tap in Settings.

Apple Health data is read on your device and re-derived per device, so your Health history itself is not uploaded.

There are no third-party analytics, tracking, or advertising SDKs. Anonymous diagnostics key on a random install identifier with no link to your account.

Requires iOS 27 or later. Apple Intelligence features require iPhone 15 Pro / iPhone 15 Pro Max / iPhone 16 and later, with Apple Intelligence enabled.

Support: villain-arc@fct-technologies.com

promotionalText: Villain Arc 2.0: rebuilt from the ground up, with an FCT account that syncs every device you use, an Apple Watch companion app, and ten languages.
whatsNew:
Villain Arc 2.0 is a complete rebuild.

REBUILT: Villain Arc has been rewritten from the ground up — a faster launch, a cleaner store, and a foundation the next few years of features are built on.

NEW: A free FCT account. Sign in once and your workouts, plans, splits, and cardio sessions reach every device you use. Sync no longer runs through iCloud.

NEW: Apple Watch companion app. Rest timer, live session, and heart-rate stats on your wrist.

NEW: Ten languages — English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, and Simplified Chinese.

PLEASE NOTE: The store underneath the app changed, so workouts and plans saved in Villain Arc 1.x do not carry over to 2.0. Villain Arc 2.0 requires iOS 27.
